name: Ha Long food guide
summary: Ha Long eats squid cake on the boats and at Tết, then a morning bowl of bún bề bề or bún cù kỳ. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. Rượu ngán is the drink with the seafood. Sá sùng is Quan Lạn. Bánh gật gù is Tiên Yên.
body: Eat Hạ Long for chả mực. The squid cake is on the cruise boats, at provincial banquets, and on the Tết table, with xôi chả mực and bún cù kỳ beside it. Morning is bún bề bề, bánh cuốn chả mực, cháo trai, and the seafood noodles, then sam and ốc xào dừa. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. A home-style seafood meal is grilled and boiled shellfish, three sour soups, and rượu ngán.

The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00. Friday and Saturday, phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00, and Công luận also counts holidays and Tết. Sá sùng belongs to Quan Lạn and Vân Đồn. Mực một nắng is Cô Tô on the provincial list, and it is also a gift at chợ Hạ Long 1 and 2. Ruốc is Quảng Yên on that list, and ruốc tôm is sold at those same markets. Bánh gật gù is Tiên Yên.
specialtiesLead: Chả mực comes first, then the rice with the cake, the morning noodles, the home-style seafood, the sweets, and rượu ngán.

highlights: Bún hải sản and bánh đa hải sản
Hải sản at Bãi Cháy and Hạ Long
Bề bề hấp or rang muối

paragraphs: The plates are the squid cake, the rice with it, the morning noodles, and the home-style seafood, then the sweets and rượu ngán.
Prices from 2019, 2020, and 2021 stay with the year and the publisher. Where two prices were printed, both stay.

sections.heading: Casual dining
paragraphs: Phố đi bộ Bài Thơ runs 18:00–24:00 on Friday and Saturday. Công luận also counts holidays and Tết. Dân trí prints Friday and Saturday. The 2023 reports say phường Bạch Đằng. From 2025 that ward is inside phường Hồng Gai. After dark on the Bãi Cháy side, phố đi bộ Bãi Cháy, chợ đêm Hạ Long, and Sun Carnival Plaza sit together.
The fast-food counter is inside Sun World. The seafood market under Núi Bài Thơ runs from 4:30 and is done before 7:00. Chợ Hạ Long 2 is on đường Lê Lợi. VuiFest is in phường Bãi Cháy.

sections.heading: Themed dining
paragraphs: The Dragon Park buffet, the set meals with the cable car and the fireworks, the 2024 beer-and-squid-cake festival, and the squid cake on the cruise boats.

The combos are tickets. Queen cable car plus the food set is 450,000 đồng for an adult and 350,000 for a child. Queen cable car plus the VUI-Fest set is 650,000 and 550,000. Queen cable car plus the Bavaria set is 750,000 and 650,000. The basic cable table defines a child as 1 m–1.4 m. These combo lines say trẻ em.

sections.heading: Breakfast
paragraphs: Bún bề bề, bún cù kỳ, bánh cuốn chả mực, cháo trai, and bún hải sản are morning plates. Phở is the other breakfast in the city center and at Bãi Cháy. Phở tôm is on a morning list with bún, bề bề, and cù kỳ.

seoTitle: Ha Long food — squid cake, morning noodles, and rượu ngán
seoDescription: Eat chả mực hot with rice sheets or rice, then bún bề bề or bún cù kỳ. Sữa chua trân châu and bánh trôi tàu are the sweets. Rượu ngán goes with the seafood.
